scope: Scientific processing software and derived analytical outputs
data_source: NASA FIRMS MODIS Terra/Aqua and Suomi-NPP VIIRS observations
derived_results: Calculated from authentic source observations using reproducible Python and JavaScript code developed with SI assistance; not generated as observations by a language model.
scientific_limits: Missing observations are not invented. No unvalidated calibration coefficient is applied. Cell-days describe recorded grid occupancy, not individual wildfires or burned area.
